Бета-глюканы овса.about: Oat Soluble Fiber: Lowers LDL and cholesterol when high; FDA/EFSA approved.
Бета-глюканы овса.caution: Oat beta-glucans are soluble fiber. FDA health claim (USA) officially approved: 'soluble fiber from oats may reduce the risk of CVD by lowering cholesterol'. A meta-analysis (35631184) confirms a decrease in LDL in hypercholesterolemic individuals. The effect is dose dependent: optimum 3+ g/day. For glycemic control: data available. Safe.
Бета-глюканы овса.food_sources: Oatmeal, bran, whole oats: beta-glucan is concentrated in them; for 3 g/day - a serving of oatmeal.
Бета-глюканы овса.guidelines: The FDA and EFSA have approved the claim: 3 g/day reduces cholesterol. MA 2022 (13 RCT, 927): TC −0.24, LDL −0.27 mmol/l.
Бета-глюканы овса.how_to_choose: Oat beta-glucan 3 g/day - from oatmeal/bran or supplement; no claims about “detox”.
mechs: Binding of bile acids in the lumen: cholesterol down
No effect on TG and HDL (mechanism limited by cholesterol)
TG −0.04 and HDL 0.00 mmol/l: no effect (NS)
Бета-глюканы овса.myths: “Reduces TG and increases HDL” - has no effect on either one (MA 2022). “Beta-glucan is stronger than statins” - the reduction in LDL is modest.
Бета-глюканы овса.name: Oat Beta-Glucans
Бета-глюканы овса.onset: The effect is dose-dependent: at 3 g/day, LDL decreases over weeks of administration, not at once.
Бета-глюканы овса.title: Oat Beta-Glucans
Бета-глюканы овса.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Бета-глюканы овса.who_needs: Hypercholesterolemia and high risk of CVD - lowering LDL as a dietary measure; in healthy people the effect is small.
